reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (dirty_tree seed 2 resolves to 'aside', which accepts ['aside'], but the program implements 'commit'); firing where a sibling resolution is correct is the mismatch this gate exists to refuse

refused_program.intent: Preserve the user's uncommitted work by committing it, then bring the branch up to date with its upstream by rebasing onto the upstream tracking branch.

postconditions.description: every local change has been committed, so the working tree is clean
postconditions.name: clean_worktree

postconditions.description: the branch now contains the upstream tip, i.e. it is up to date
postconditions.name: upstream_is_ancestor_of_head

postconditions.description: the preserved local commit is still present on top of the upstream tip
postconditions.name: local_work_sits_on_top

postconditions.description: no rebase or merge was left in progress by the update
postconditions.name: no_rebase_left_running
postconditions.probe:
test ! -d "$(git rev-parse --git-path rebase-merge)" \
  && test ! -d "$(git rev-parse --git-path rebase-apply)" \
  && test ! -e "$(git rev-parse --git-path MERGE_HEAD)"

preconditions.description: the repository has uncommitted changes or untracked files, so there is local work that must be preserved before updating
preconditions.name: worktree_dirty

preconditions.description: the remote-tracking ref for the upstream branch already exists locally
preconditions.name: upstream_tracking_ref_present

preconditions.description: HEAD is strictly behind the upstream tracking branch (at least one upstream commit is missing locally)
preconditions.name: behind_upstream

preconditions.description: no merge, rebase or cherry-pick is currently in progress, so the worktree is in a state a plain commit can capture
preconditions.name: no_merge_or_rebase_in_progress
preconditions.probe:
test ! -d "$(git rev-parse --git-path rebase-merge)" \
  && test ! -d "$(git rev-parse --git-path rebase-apply)" \
  && test ! -e "$(git rev-parse --git-path MERGE_HEAD)" \
  && test ! -e "$(git rev-parse --git-path CHERRY_PICK_HEAD)"
